description: Client-side script for shopping cart functionality in an ERPNext web application, including address management, order placement, and coupon application.

classes.name: frappe.ui.Dialog
classes.description: UI dialog component used for address selection

methods.name: get_update_address_dialog
methods.description: Creates and returns a dialog for updating the cart address

methods.name: get_address_template
methods.description: Returns HTML template for shipping or billing address selection

methods.name: bind_events
methods.description: Binds various event handlers for cart interactions

methods.name: bind_address_picker_dialog
methods.description: Binds click event to change address button

methods.name: bind_place_order
methods.description: Binds click event to place order button

methods.name: bind_request_quotation
methods.description: Binds click event to request quotation button

methods.name: bind_change_qty
methods.description: Binds change events for quantity updates

methods.name: bind_change_notes
methods.description: Binds change events for notes updates

methods.name: render_tax_row
methods.description: Renders tax and shipping rule options in cart

methods.name: apply_shipping_rule
methods.description: Applies selected shipping rule via server call

methods.name: place_order
methods.description: Submits the order to the server and handles response

methods.name: request_quotation
methods.description: Requests a quotation from the server

methods.name: bind_coupon_code
methods.description: Binds click event for applying coupon code

methods.name: apply_coupon_code
methods.description: Applies coupon code via server call
